scope: Actual independent offline SQLite registration and readback of frozen technical context. No executor rerun, historical authorization, model decision or native-quality improvement.
registry_storage: Independent :memory: SQLite database per episode, closed after logical receipt; no SQLite files retained.

scope_integrity.scope_note: All 3378 episodes executed in separate SQLite databases; IDs are local replay bindings, not historical authority. No concurrency or production atomicity claim.

state_registration_note: 159647 is the number of latest native observation field-hash slots at episode end, not financial decisions or a count of distinct mutations. Only causally paired actual native results are imported, retaining source refs and source sequence.
